names.explanation: His mercy is vast and reaches every creature in this world, believer and disbeliever alike.
He shows special, lasting mercy to those who believe, above all in the Hereafter.
The true Sovereign of all that exists, whose rule needs no one and never ends.
Free of every flaw, need and imperfection, far above anything unworthy of Him.
Perfect and free of all defect, He is the source of peace and safety for His creation.
He grants safety and faith, and confirms the truth of His word and His messengers.
He watches over and protects all things, and nothing escapes His care.
Mighty and honoured, He is never overcome and none can resist His will.
He sets right what is broken and brings all things under His will.
All true greatness belongs to Him alone, above everything He has created.
He brings things into being from nothing, by His knowledge and decree.
He brings creation into existence free of flaw and in perfect balance.
He gives every creature its unique form and appearance.
He forgives again and again, however often His servants return to Him.
He prevails over all things, and everything submits to His power.
He gives freely and endlessly, without being asked and without any return.
He provides for every living being, in body and in soul.
He opens the doors of mercy and provision, and judges between people with truth.
His knowledge covers everything, hidden and open, past, present and future.
In His wisdom He holds back provision and constricts hearts as He wills.
He expands provision and opens hearts generously for whom He wills.
He lowers the arrogant and the oppressor in His perfect justice.
He raises in rank the believers and those given knowledge.
True honour comes only from Him, and He grants it to whom He wills.
He humbles whom He wills, and none can honour whom He has disgraced.
He hears every voice and every whispered prayer, in every language at once.
He sees all things, however small or hidden they may be.
He is the final judge, and His judgement is always just.
He is perfectly just, and never wrongs anyone by even an atom's weight.
He knows the finest details and is gentle to His servants in ways they may not see.
He is aware of the inner reality of all things, and nothing is hidden from Him.
He does not hasten to punish, giving His servants time to repent.
His greatness is beyond the reach of minds and the limits of description.
He covers sins and forgives them completely, however great they are.
He rewards even small good deeds with a great reward.
He is above all things in His essence, His rank and His power.
He is greater than everything, and everything is small before Him.
He guards His creation and keeps a record of every deed.
He gives every creature the sustenance and strength it needs.
He takes account of all deeds, and He is sufficient for those who rely on Him.
He possesses every quality of majesty and grandeur.
He gives abundantly, forgives freely and honours those who turn to Him.
He watches over every soul and every action, at every moment.
He answers the call of those who pray to Him.
His knowledge, mercy and generosity have no limit.
Everything He creates and decrees has perfect wisdom behind it.
He loves His righteous servants and places love for them in hearts.
His glory is perfect, and His generosity is vast.
He will raise all people from their graves on the Day of Judgement.
He witnesses all things, and nothing happens out of His sight.
He is the absolute Truth, and His existence and promise are certain.
He is the best to rely on, and He takes care of all the affairs of those who trust Him.
His strength is perfect and never weakens or tires.
His power is firm and unshakeable, needing no help from anyone.
He is the ally and helper of the believers, bringing them out of darkness into light.
All praise belongs to Him, whether or not anyone praises Him.
He counts and knows the number of all things, down to every breath and leaf.
He began creation the first time, without any model before it.
He will bring creation back to life after death.
He gives life to the body, and gives life to hearts with faith.
He decrees death for every living being at its appointed time.
His life is perfect and eternal, with no beginning and no end.
He needs nothing, and everything depends on Him to exist.
He lacks nothing and finds whatever He wills, whenever He wills.
He is noble and honoured, with perfect glory and generosity.
He is one in His essence, His attributes and His actions.
He is uniquely One, with no partner, equal or likeness.
All creation turns to Him in need, while He needs no one.
He is able to do anything He wills.
His power is complete over everything, and nothing can stop Him.
He brings forward whom and what He wills, in His wisdom.
He holds back whom and what He wills, in His wisdom.
He existed before everything, with no beginning.
He remains after everything has perished, with no end.
His existence is evident in everything, and nothing is above Him.
He is hidden from sight, and nothing is closer than Him.
He governs and manages all the affairs of creation.
He is exalted far above the attributes of His creation.
He is kind and good to His servants, and His goodness is everywhere.
He guides His servants to repent and accepts their repentance again and again.
He brings justice against those who persist in wrongdoing.
He erases sins completely, as if they had never been.
His compassion is gentle and tender towards His servants.
All dominion is His, and He gives and takes it from whom He wills.
He is the possessor of all majesty, and the source of all honour and generosity.
He acts with perfect fairness and gives everyone their due.
He will gather all people together on the Day of Judgement.
He is rich beyond all need, and all creation needs Him.
He enriches whom He wills and frees them from need of others.
He withholds what He wills, protecting His servants from harm.
No harm happens except by His decree, and in it there is wisdom.
All benefit comes from Him alone.
He is the Light of the heavens and the earth, and He guides hearts with His light.
He guides His servants to what benefits them, and to the straight path.
He created the heavens and the earth with no model before them.
He remains forever, while everything else will perish.
He remains after all creation, and everything returns to Him.

names.english: The Guide to the Right Path
names.explanation: All His actions are rightly guided, and He leads to what is right.
He is patient with His servants and does not hasten to punish them.
